reviews.text:
Zero stars.... DO NOT take your dog here
This lady is so rude and mistreats dogs. There is a high powered blow drier that hits your dogs ear for about 15 minutes and she doesn't care... she uses cold water and if I wasn't there this old woman would have been hitting my dog when he reacted to her hurting the dog. She was not allowed to finish the grooming! I took my dog out of there asap. Do not trust her with your fur pets if you love and care about them. Not to mention the hard metal comb she scrapes on their dry fur to take out the tangles with out detangling shampoo or spray. I am truly sorry I ever took my pup there to begin with. She is rude and called me dramatic and over reacting when I told her to stop the grooming. I almost felt like she would have gotten physical with me too. DO NOT GO HERE!
